name: jsonscraper
description: Read profiles, posts, comments and available statistics through licensed jsonscraper APIs.

interface.shortDescription: Structured social data for your workflows
interface.longDescription: Retrieve Instagram and TikTok profiles, posts, comments, search results and available statistics through jsonscraper APIs. Connect one or both product licenses on the secure authorization page. Each product has its own license, plan and request quota. Tools retrieve data and do not publish posts, send messages or manage accounts. Availability depends on the source and endpoint; do not assume every returned field is available or current. jsonscraper is an independent service, not affiliated with Meta or TikTok.
defaultPrompt: Read the Instagram profile apple and summarize the returned statistics. Use one request.
Read the TikTok profile therock and summarize the returned statistics. Use one request.

positive.prompt: Use jsonscraper to read the public profile apple. Make one API request.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public profile or report an upstream error honestly. Do not invent unavailable fields.

positive.prompt: Use jsonscraper to summarize the public profile nasa. Make one API request.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the returned public account data; identify absent fields.

positive.prompt: Use jsonscraper to read the public profile therock. Make one API request.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public profile or report an upstream error honestly. Do not invent unavailable fields.

positive.prompt: Use jsonscraper to summarize the public profile tiktok. Make one API request.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the returned public account data; identify absent fields.

positive.description: Compare available statistics across connected products
positive.prompt: Read Instagram profile apple and TikTok profile therock. Present returned statistics separately, using at most two API requests.
positive.expected_behavior: Use each product license only for its own tool. Identify missing data and do not imply metrics are directly equivalent.

negative.description: Unsupported write operation; explain supported read tools without making an API call.
negative.prompt: Post a comment on TikTok as therock.

negative.description: No private messages tool; do not promise access to restricted data.
Missing product license; explain how to reconnect and add it on the authorization page. Never ask for a key in chat.
negative.prompt: Only my TikTok license is connected. Read Instagram profile apple.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. An existing paid API license and normal plan quota are required.

publication.release_notes: One jsonscraper connection at https://mcp.jsonscraper.com. Independently verify Instagram and TikTok licenses, connect one or both, and expose only entitled tools. Unified icon, review login and setup documentation. No checkout links in authorization.
